<tspan x="983.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="983.0" y="894" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="983.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>

sourceProfile.output: similarity feature vector, not scalar probability
sourceProfile.selected_configuration: explicit static module profile; not a runtime observation

sourceFacts: Source class is misspelled TenorNetworkModule; stable source identity keeps that spelling while display label explains neural tensor comparison.
Tensor weight[8,8,4] contracts ordered graph columns in two actual matrix products with an intermediate view[8,4]. A separate block weight[4,16] acts on concatenated graph vectors.
Bilinear features, block features and owned bias add before ReLU. This module returns four features, not a similarity probability or scalar graph edit distance.
Graph ranks only allocate space. Explicit edges supply real operands; no upstream code is imported or executed.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
